prompt: Create a vertical full-body fantasy anime character illustration on a clean off-white background: a young girl named Leticia standing front-facing in a whimsical Halloween forest-spirit theme. She has a small chibi-like body, pale skin, a soft serious expression, large gray-brown eyes, short black bangs, and twin ponytails with teal-blue gradient tips. She wears oversized futuristic black cat-ear headphones with glowing cyan triangular ear lights and cyan ring accents. Her outfit is an elaborate layered poncho cloak in cream, burnt orange, black, and muted teal, decorated with patchwork triangles, tiny ghosts, skulls, stars, stitches, tassels, beads, charms, and a big orange bow at the collar; underneath are a dark skirt, striped black-and-cream thigh socks, and chunky brown adventure boots with small orange creature faces on the toes. In her left hand she holds a crooked bare tree-branch staff; hanging from it are exactly 3 visible items: a small skull-tag charm, a glowing blue-green metal lantern, and a dangling tiny bell/ornament. Perched at the top of the staff is exactly 1 owl-like fantasy creature with round orange eyes, bat wings, a scarf, feather tufts, and speckled plumage. Surround the girl with exactly 7 companion creatures: 1 tall smoky dark ghost behind her right shoulder with glowing eyes and jagged mouth, 1 pale beige blob ghost at lower left with two large holes, 1 black cat with orange eyes at her feet, 1 small pale tan ghost near the cat, 1 teal-blue stitched ghost at lower right, 1 small pale floating ghost above the teal ghost, and 1 black round bat/cat face peeking from the cloak pocket. Add delicate plants, tiny flowers, fallen leaves, watercolor splashes, and small floating motes around the feet and background. Use a highly detailed Japanese watercolor-and-ink manga style with soft washes, fine linework, muted autumn colors, cute spooky atmosphere, transparent layered fabric, and a centered composition. Add a handwritten signature at the bottom right reading Leticia. No panels, no speech bubbles, no UI elements, no extra text.

promptZh: 在干净的灰白色背景上创作一张垂直全身的奇幻动漫角色插画：一位名为 Leticia 的少女正面站立，主题为奇幻的万圣节森林精灵。她拥有娇小的 Q 版身材、白皙的皮肤、柔和而严肃的表情、大大的灰褐色眼睛、黑色短刘海以及发梢带有青蓝色渐变的双马尾。她佩戴着超大号的未来感黑色猫耳耳机，耳机上有发光的青色三角形耳灯和青色圆环装饰。她的服装是一件精致的叠层斗篷，颜色为 奶油色、焦橙色、黑色和柔和的青色，装饰有三角形拼布、小幽灵、骷髅、星星、缝线、流苏、珠子、挂饰，领口处有一个巨大的橙色蝴蝶结；内搭深色短裙、黑白条纹大腿袜，脚穿带有橙色小生物脸部图案的棕色厚底冒险靴。她的左手握着一根弯曲的枯树枝法杖；杖上悬挂着 3 个清晰可见的物品：一个小骷髅吊牌、一盏发着蓝绿色光的金属灯笼，以及一个悬挂的小铃铛/装饰品。法杖顶端栖息着 1 只猫头鹰般的奇幻生物，长着圆圆的橙色眼睛、蝙蝠翅膀、围巾、羽簇和斑点羽毛。在少女周围环绕着 7 只伙伴生物：右肩后方有 1 只高大的烟雾状深色幽灵，长着发光的眼睛和锯齿状的嘴；左下方有 1 只带有两个大洞的浅米色团状幽灵；脚边有 1 只橙色眼睛的黑猫；猫附近有 1 只浅棕色的小幽灵；右下方有 1 只青蓝色的缝合幽灵；青色幽灵上方有 1 只漂浮的小幽灵；斗篷口袋里探出 1 只圆形的黑色蝙蝠/猫脸。在脚部和背景周围添加精致的植物、小花、落叶、水彩溅墨和漂浮的微尘。采用高度精细的日式水墨漫画风格，结合柔和的渲染、细腻的线条、柔和的秋季色调、可爱而诡异的氛围、透明的叠层织物，采用居中构图。在右下角添加手写签名，内容为 Leticia。不要有分镜、对话框、UI 元素或额外文字。
